findings.encoding_fix: V3 explicitly specifies -Encoding UTF8 when reading the gate JSON, addressing the PowerShell 5.1 ANSI default that caused the prior pre-open abort. Parent reports the same gate parsed successfully offline in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and the script syntax check passed.
findings.gates: The independent retry2 passed result remains the only IO4-entry artifact. The script checks passed, exact serial, forced recovery and matching saved revision, then rechecks runtime identity/version/current mode/profile/status/slots/revision and exact gate revision before any mode mutation.
findings.write_path: If all gates pass, operations remain set startup mode, preview check, save, saved-state check, reboot request; the port is closed in finally. The script does not itself prove post-reboot IO4 enumeration or HID report delivery; those require separate evidence.
findings.return_path: NORMAL_NKRO return requires a fresh forced-recovery session and saved IO4 mode, consistent with the demonstrated GP9 path. The post-short functional recovery gate does not establish electrical health.

recommendation: V3 is ready for a separately reviewed execution attempt under the already authorized test plan. Review the resulting CDC requests and state before any further steps; classify reboot ACK separately from successful IO4 enumeration/HID reads.
